comment: Known advisories accepted on purpose, each with a reason and an expiry. scripts/audit-check.mjs (CI) fails on any advisory not listed here and on any expired entry.

exceptions.reason: Bundled inside aws-cdk-lib (inBundle), so overrides can't reach it, and no aws-cdk-lib release ships minimatch >= 11.0.1 yet. Used only at synth time on our own globs (CI and the developer machine), never on the production host.
exceptions.remove_when: an aws-cdk-lib release that bundles minimatch >= 11.0.1 passes the 14-day rule

exceptions.reason: Dev/build tooling only (vite, vitest): not in any production tree (npm ls --omit=dev is clean in api, web and infra), and its globs come only from our own config. No fixed picomatch exists yet (the advisory covers <= 4.0.7, the newest release). Accepted by the owner on 2026-11-18.
exceptions.remove_when: a fixed picomatch passes the 14-day rule
